title: medical_report
description: Fields extracted from a clinical report. Note the deliberately narrow field set: this class carries the highest re-identification risk of the four, so only fields with a downstream processing need are extracted.

patient_reference.description: Pseudonymous patient identifier (MRN or study id). Never a patient name — the pipeline treats names as data to be dropped, not extracted.

report_date.description: Date the report was issued, ISO 8601 date.

ordering_clinician.description: Name of the clinician who ordered the investigation.

abnormal_flag.description: Whether the report records any out-of-reference-range result.
